title: Russian Strikes on Ukraine Hits Near David Petraeus, ex-C.I.A. Chief
summary: David Petraeus was at a rail station when a drone hit. Another train, with former Prime Minister Boris Johnson of Britain and other dignitaries, had just left, Ukrainian officials said.
